status: PILOT: exploratory sizing on the public pilot seeds; not evidence, never preregistered, authorized or admitted, and its seeds never feed an archived run

control.label: the same stimuli every 90 s on the same schedule

doses.label: repeating a looming stimulus every 5 s on a fixed schedule
repeating a looming stimulus every 10 s on a fixed schedule
repeating a looming stimulus every 20 s on a fixed schedule
repeating a looming stimulus every 40 s on a fixed schedule

null.label: null: the control again on the next 32 pilot seeds, paired in order

sized.rule: seed_count: the smallest of 8-16 whose chance of passing G3, G4 (6 untied) and the exact sign test at alpha 0.05 is at least 0.9, with the expected direction's share at its one-sided 95% lower bound; minimum_effect: the pilot's mean paired difference less 1.645 standard errors (pilot and experiment), rounded down to two significant figures, so S1 holds with about 95% probability for an effect the size of the pilot's; the design uses the larger of it and the host's minimum effect
